name: gemini-as-mcp

tools.name: ask-gemini
tools.description: Ask Gemini with massive 2M+ token context. Automatically uses built-in tools: web search, URL fetching, file analysis via @ syntax. Supports sandbox mode for code execution and changeMode for structured edits.

prompt.description: Analysis request. Supports: 1) @ syntax for files/dirs (e.g., '@src/' or '@file.js'), 2) Web search ('search for latest React 19 features'), 3) URL fetching ('summarize https://example.com'), 4) Code execution in sandbox mode, 5) General questions. Gemini automatically uses web_search and web_fetch tools when needed.

model.description: Optional model to use (e.g., 'gemini-3-pro-preview', 'gemini-2.5-pro'). If not specified, uses the default model (gemini-3-flash-preview).

sandbox.description: Use sandbox mode (-s flag) to safely test code changes, execute scripts, or run potentially risky operations in an isolated environment

changeMode.description: Enable structured change mode - formats prompts to prevent tool errors and returns structured edit suggestions that Claude can apply directly

tools.name: web-search
tools.description: Search the web using Gemini's google_web_search tool. Returns AI-processed summaries with citations, not raw search results. Perfect for: latest documentation, current events, API updates, tutorials, package info.

query.description: Search query. Gemini will use google_web_search tool to find current information and return a processed summary with citations.

tools.name: web-fetch
tools.description: Fetch and process web content using Gemini's web_fetch tool. Handles 1-20 URLs. Perfect for: fetching latest API docs, comparing documentation, extracting code examples, summarizing articles/blogs.

urls.description: One or more URLs to fetch and analyze (http:// or https://). Can be a single URL string or array of URLs.

instruction.description: What to do with the fetched content (e.g., 'summarize key points', 'compare these APIs', 'extract code examples')

tools.name: analyze-codebase
tools.description: Analyze large codebases using Gemini's 2M+ token context window. Handles entire directories, multiple files, or whole projects. Perfect for: understanding architecture, finding patterns, analyzing dependencies, code review.

paths.description: File or directory paths to analyze. Use @ syntax: '@src/', '@package.json', '@./'. Can be single path or array of paths.

question.description: What you want to know about the codebase (e.g., 'explain the architecture', 'find all API endpoints', 'summarize the auth flow')

tools.name: verify-implementation
tools.description: Verify if features, patterns, or security measures are implemented in a codebase. Uses Gemini's large context to search entire project. Returns specific files, functions, and implementation details.

paths.description: Directories/files to search in. Use @ syntax: '@src/', '@lib/', '@./'. Can be single path or array.

feature.description: Feature or pattern to check for (e.g., 'JWT authentication', 'dark mode', 'rate limiting', 'WebSocket connections', 'Redis caching')

details.description: Optional: Specific aspects to verify (e.g., 'Show me the middleware functions', 'List all endpoints', 'Check error handling')

tools.name: brainstorm
tools.description: Generate novel ideas with dynamic context gathering. --> Creative frameworks (SCAMPER, Design Thinking, etc.), domain context integration, idea clustering, feasibility analysis, and iterative refinement.

prompt.description: Primary brainstorming challenge or question to explore

model.description: Optional model to use (e.g., 'gemini-3-pro-preview', 'gemini-2.5-pro'). If not specified, uses the default model (gemini-3-flash-preview).

methodology.description: Brainstorming framework: 'divergent' (generate many ideas), 'convergent' (refine existing), 'scamper' (systematic triggers), 'design-thinking' (human-centered), 'lateral' (unexpected connections), 'auto' (AI selects best)

constraints.description: Known limitations, requirements, or boundaries (budget, time, technical, legal, etc.)

existingContext.description: Background information, previous attempts, or current state to build upon

ideaCount.description: Target number of ideas to generate (default: 10-15)

includeAnalysis.description: Include feasibility, impact, and implementation analysis for generated ideas

tools.name: fetch-chunk
tools.description: Retrieves cached chunks from a changeMode response. Use this to get subsequent chunks after receiving a partial changeMode response.

cacheKey.description: The cache key provided in the initial changeMode response

tools.name: timeout-test
tools.description: Test timeout prevention by running for a specified duration
